title: Project Context

empty.title: No spec files yet
empty.body: Drop your PRDs, tech specs, and acceptance criteria under .devdigest/specs/. Every agent and the PR brief read them as grounding context.

editor.localOnlyWarning: Saves live only in this local clone — they are not committed or pushed, and can be lost on re-index.

detail.placeholder: Select a document to preview or edit it.
detail.readOnlyReason: This document is outside .devdigest/specs/, so it’s preview-only.

conflict.message: This document changed on disk since you loaded it. Your copy is stale.

create.collision: A file or folder with that name already exists.
create.invalidName: That name isn’t valid. Use letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

upload.tooLarge: File is too large to upload.
upload.collision: A file with that name already exists.

folderInvisibleNote: An empty folder won’t appear in the list until it contains a document.

reindexConfirm.title: Re-index this repo?
reindexConfirm.body: Re-indexing discards any unsaved edits and can lose documents written since the last refresh — they are not committed or pushed anywhere.

unsavedConfirm.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedConfirm.body: You have unsaved edits. Leaving now will discard them.

picker.orderHint: Order matters — documents are injected in this order. Drag to reorder.
picker.combinedTotalTokens: {tokens} tokens total for this agent + linked skills
picker.overCapHint: Over the {cap}-token soft budget — attaching still works, but review cost will be higher.
picker.mapReduceNote: This agent runs map-reduce — attached context is re-sent for every changed file, multiplying its token cost.
